## About Me

I am a marketing and fashion industry professional developing expertise in marketing data science. My interests sit at the intersection of consumer behavior, brand storytelling, fashion merchandising, and data-informed decision-making.

I enjoy translating customer and market information into insights that help brands create more relevant products and more meaningful experiences. This portfolio demonstrates how I use Quarto to communicate analysis clearly to an audience.

## Career Aspirations

My goal is to build a career in fashion marketing, brand strategy, or consumer insights. I hope to combine my practical experience in the fashion industry with analytical skills to understand customers, evaluate marketing performance, and support better business decisions.
